title: GoHighLevel (GHL) & AI Automation Specialist
description_text: Condensed from the public post. Build and optimize marketing funnels and automation workflows in GoHighLevel for the agency and clients. Set up pipelines, triggers, calendars, forms, surveys, memberships, and SMS/email/voicemail campaigns. Own client GHL account setup from scratch including integrations and tracking. Maintain CRM data and troubleshoot GHL workflow bugs. Build and optimize AI chatbots for lead qualification, FAQs, and support. Generate reports from campaign data, call logs, and CRM activity. Build advanced automations in Make, Zapier, or n8n. Support landing pages, nurture sequences, email/SMS campaigns, and performance analysis. Must have proven hands-on GHL experience including debugging complex workflows, practical AI tool use (chatbots, data analysis, reporting), digital marketing knowledge, and strong written and verbal English. Nice to have: Make/Zapier/n8n, Meta Ads, landing page building (WordPress, Webflow, GHL), SEO, email marketing, copywriting, basic JavaScript or Python.

experience_requirements: Hands-on GoHighLevel experience debugging complex workflows
Practical use of AI tools for chatbots, data analysis, and reporting
key_responsibilities: Build marketing funnels and automation workflows
Build AI chatbots for lead qualification
Reporting from campaign and CRM data
